<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm) are at 131.87, 129.70 (two signals), 129.01 (two signals), and 129.00 ppm – a total of six distinct aromatic carbon signals, which corresponds to a benzene ring containing six aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
